project.objective: Sort out which of the conflicting vital records on Cornelius Brady's profile belong to him

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Plain language for someone who has never done genealogy. No identifiers, file names, tool names or field names. Do not narrate between actions; report once when the step is done: what was found, in one paragraph, and what happens next in one sentence.

questions.question: Which of the dated facts on Cornelius Brady's profile belong to him, and which were attached in error?
questions.rationale: The profile carries a christening dated before its own birth, a burial dated before its own death, a marriage at age twelve, and a residence seventeen years after death. Several were auto-attached from indexes. Until the wrong ones are identified and detached, no conclusion about him is defensible.

query.collection: Catholic Parish Registers, King's County, Ireland

log.notes: Baptism of 4 June 1845 names Owen Brady as father. A separate indexed Kilcormac entry carries the year 1843 only and may belong to a different child of the same parish.

sources.citation: Catholic Parish Registers, Kilcormac, King's County, Ireland, baptism of Cornelius Brady, 4 June 1845; digital image, FamilySearch.org, accessed 19 Sep 2026.
sources.notes: Names Owen Brady as father. This is the strongest date on the profile.

sources.citation: Kilcormac Parish Burial Register, burial of Owen Brady, 10 February 1843; digital image, FamilySearch.org, accessed 19 Sep 2026.
sources.notes: Owen Brady's burial predates Cornelius's baptism by more than two years, yet the baptism names Owen as the father. One of the two entries concerns a different Owen Brady.

assertions.place: Parish of Kilcormac, King's County, Ireland

assertions.informant_bias_notes: If this is the same Owen Brady named as father in the 1845 baptism, he died more than two years before that child was born.
